title: 第17章 山海造化珠上第18章 山海造化珠下
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
林道眼中精芒闪烁，看样子老办法，滴血认亲，跟当初神秘玉佩一样。
其实对于玉佩林道有了某种猜测，玉佩要么就是某种至宝，或某种传承。
林道开始滴血认主时，并没有被认可，是林道自身血液太次。
但当林道伤口触碰玉佩时，玉佩本身需要大量的血液充能，所以把林道当做口粮了。
玉佩碎裂，金色血液出现，林道从一开始就想差了，以为金色血液是玉佩独有的。
但并不是，金色血液本是林道自己的，只是玉佩将林道自身凡血升华高等血液。
林道费了老大的劲，才将手指咬破，肉体太强了也不好，一滴晶莹剔透的血液，滴在神秘石珠上。
但很快被神秘石珠吸收，林道精神一震，果然如此，玉佩那次滴血，是自己的血液太次了。
神秘石珠吸了血并没有反应，林道知道一滴血太少了，但他并没有猛撞的，把咬破的手指贴到石珠上，因为有心理阴影，血的教训。
这也证实了，某种至宝需要高等级的血液才能认主。
因为在得到石珠时，上面沾满独狼的血迹，显然石珠并没有与独狼认主。
林道飞快将血液逼出，一滴两滴直到四十九滴，随着血液被石珠迅速吸收，石珠表皮也发生惊人的变化。
石珠灰色表皮开始演化成金色，血色的纹路陆续的，在金色表皮快速勾勒，使金色的珠子显得古朴大气与神秘莫测。
林道心中激动不已，因为他已经感应到自己与金色珠子有了某种联系。
这时金色珠子主动飞离林道手心，林道一愣，连忙伸手想要拦截，但很快就制止了。
因为金色珠子浮空停在林道身前，就在林道怔忡之际，金色珠子疾速旋转起来，一股强大的引力从金色珠子里涌出。
林道脸色一变，就见以金色珠子为中心，形成一乒乓球大小黑洞，开始吸收空气中某种物质。
见到此景，林道猛着睁开黄金之瞳，在黄金之瞳注视下，一缕缕灰色气流，从虚空飞速涌入金色珠子中，很快这样场景以飞快的速度，向四周扩散开来。
随着金色珠子吸收灰色气流越来越多，金色珠子上，红色纹路开始缓缓消退，金色珠子发出微弱亳光。
林道眼神凝重，在黄金之瞳凝视下，金色珠子化作金色能量珠，在其体内无数条黑色裂缝，好似要将金色珠子撕裂。

这一刻林道已经明白，金色珠子极有可能遭遇某种重创，不得不神物自晦。
金色珠子上的血色纹路，应该是林道以血液修复了一些裂缝，让金色珠子复苏，自主吸收某种物质来补充自身。
随着金色珠子牵引力越发强劲，所形成景象越发恐怖。
在林道黄金之瞳注视下，天空中形成一股庞大灰色旋涡漏斗，开始倒灌入金色珠子里。
林道脸色难看，这样场景若是持续下去，必然被某些人注意到，到时候自己可无法控制。
庆幸的是，灰色气流普通人注意不到，不然这里已经暴露了。
东南省省府，一座通天塔楼里，塔楼顶端楼层里，一面巨大古朴镜子摆放其中，镜面上闪烁着红色波动。
镜子旁正有位盘膝打坐，面容清癯须发皆白的老人。
这时老人身形微动，睁开眼睛，眼神深邃望着镜中红色波动。
老人微微皱眉，喃喃自语：“这又是哪个不知死活的，在打灵脉的主意，如此大量的吸收灵气，难道是地宗那帮疯子。”
老人想起那帮疯子也不免头疼，那帮疯子走的修行路，是以己身融灵脉与地脉的路子。
想到此老人脸色一变，连忙站起身来，来到巨大镜子前，手掐法诀，一束流光从指间射入镜面之上。
content_en:
Lin Dao's eyes flashed, and it looked like the old method of recognizing relatives with blood, just like the mysterious jade pendant.
In fact, Lin Dao has some speculation about the jade pendant. The jade pendant is either some kind of treasure or some kind of inheritance.
When Lin Dao began to shed blood to identify his master, he was not recognized because Lin Dao's own blood was too low.
But when Lin Dao's wound touched the jade pendant, the jade pendant itself needed a lot of blood to charge, so Lin Dao was used as a ration.
The jade pendant shattered and golden blood appeared. Lin Dao was wrong from the beginning, thinking that golden blood was unique to the jade pendant.
But no, the golden blood was originally Lin Dao's own, but the jade pendant sublimated Lin Dao's own mortal blood into higher blood.
It took a lot of effort from Lin Dao to bite his finger. It was not good if his body was too strong. A drop of crystal clear blood dripped on the mysterious stone bead.
But it was quickly absorbed by the mysterious stone bead, and Lin Dao was shocked. Sure enough, the blood dripping from the jade pendant was his own blood.
The mysterious stone bead sucked the blood and did not react. Lin Dao knew that one drop of blood was too little, but he did not rush and put his bitten finger on the stone bead because of the psychological shadow and the lesson of blood.
This also confirms that a certain kind of treasure requires high-level blood to recognize its owner.
Because when the stone bead was obtained, it was stained with Lone Wolf's blood. Obviously, the stone bead did not recognize Lone Wolf as its owner.
Lin Dao quickly forced out the blood, one drop, two drops, until forty-nine drops. As the blood was quickly absorbed by the stone bead, the surface of the stone bead also underwent startling changes.
The gray skin of the stone beads began to evolve into gold, and blood-colored lines were quickly outlined on the golden skin, making the golden beads look primitive and mysterious.
Lin Dao was very excited because he had sensed that he had some kind of connection with the golden beads.
At this time, the golden bead took the initiative to fly away from Lin Dao's palm. Lin Dao was stunned and quickly reached out to intercept it, but was quickly stopped.
Because the golden bead floated in front of Lin Dao, and when Lin Dao was stunned, the golden bead spun rapidly, and a strong gravitational force poured out from the golden bead.
Lin Dao's expression changed, and he saw a black hole the size of a ping pong ball formed with the golden bead as the center, and began to absorb a certain substance in the air.
Seeing this scene, Lin Dao suddenly opened his golden eyes. Under the gaze of his golden eyes, wisps of gray air flowed into the golden beads from the void. Soon, the scene spread to all directions at a very fast speed.
As the golden beads absorb more and more gray airflow, the red lines on the golden beads begin to slowly fade away, and the golden beads emit a faint light.
Lin Dao's eyes were solemn. Under the gaze of the golden eyes, the golden beads turned into golden energy beads. There were countless black cracks in his body, as if they were about to tear the golden beads apart.
At this moment, Lin Dao already understood that the golden bead was most likely to suffer some serious damage and had to hide it.
The blood lines on the golden beads should be that Lin Dao repaired some cracks with blood, allowing the golden beads to revive and absorb some kind of substance to replenish themselves.
As the traction force of the golden beads becomes stronger, the scene becomes more terrifying.
Under the gaze of Lin Dao's golden eyes, a huge gray vortex funnel formed in the sky and began to pour into the golden beads.
Lin Dao looked ugly. If this scene continued, someone would definitely notice it, and he would not be able to control it at that time.
Fortunately, the gray air flow cannot be noticed by ordinary people, otherwise it would have been exposed here.
In the capital of Southeast Province, in a sky-reaching tower, on the top floor of the tower, there is a huge ancient mirror, with red waves flashing on the mirror.
There was an old man sitting cross-legged and meditating next to the mirror, with a slender face and white hair and beard.
At this time, the old man moved slightly, opened his eyes, and looked deeply at the red fluctuations in the mirror.
The old man frowned slightly and murmured to himself: "Who is this reckless person who is plotting spiritual veins and absorbing such a large amount of spiritual energy? Could it be that they are the lunatics from the Earth Sect?". "
The old man couldn't help but get a headache when he thought of those lunatics. The path of cultivation that those lunatics followed was to integrate spiritual veins and earth veins with one's own body.
Thinking of this, the old man's expression changed. He quickly stood up and came to the huge mirror. He made a magic spell with his hands and a stream of light shot from his fingers into the mirror.
